unitOfAnalysis: one fixed source case and declared scenario, not an additional independent case for a repeat
primaryFullRule: A full answer correctly decides the current scenario at its declared boundary, supports the decisive control and protected effect with supplied source, answers every explicitly requested counterfactual with a source-supported or justified unknown effect, and includes the publicly required response details. Logically equivalent wording counts.

dimensions.basis: Current scenario only, including declared-entry versus supplied-path versus deployment boundary.
Decisive authorization control, route order, protected effect, and exact supplied-source locations; citations alone do not establish semantics.
Only the branches listed in public requirements; a branch may reasonably be unknown when its decisive fact is unavailable.
Only details publicly requested for that case.
Compare observed implementation behavior against authored policy; do not accept a schema label without source-supported behavior.
Reported separately; missing unrequested details cannot lower primaryFullRule.
Keep first delivery and every actual attempt, fallback, and repair in accounting.

specialChecks: For owui-text and gitea-lock, a correct observed denial paired with source_supported_failure is a label inconsistency.

For fastapi-superuser-read, a stated current_user handler-entry premise must not be turned into a demand to prove cropped-out dependency wiring; the supplied-path variant separately tests that wiring limit.
For owui-header, a deployment conclusion needs deployment facts; source-visible application branches and any requested denial/status behavior still need explicit answers.
For gitea-assignee, token scope and repository permission are distinct; assess both requested permission-true branches.
blindEvaluation: Generate the complete first block before reading evaluator answers or scoring. Reconcile all dispatch attempts before calculating denominators.
